items.title: AFL matriarch stored guns for Dezi Freeman, helped wife get to Australia
items.description: Kay Reid, the mother of premiership players Ben and Sam Reid, reveals that she and her husband Bruce's deep ties to the dead fugitive and his family date back two decades.

items.title: 'They simply lied': Iranians devastated as US signs with regime they hoped would fall
items.description: From inside Iran, citizens say they feel abandoned and forgotten as the United States signs a deal with the regime Washington launched a war against.

items.title: 'Wake up': Vance slams Israeli critics of Iran deal
items.description: US Vice-President JD Vance lashes out at Israeli critics of the Iran deal, saying Donald Trump is Israel's only ally, in a sharp rebuke that referenced the billions in American defence aid the country receives.

items.title: Live: 'I don't see myself as a bad apple,' KPMG CEO tells parliamentary hearing
items.description: A former KPMG chief executive tells a parliamentary hearing he does not see himself "as a bad apple". Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Live: Treasurer labels reports he has frosty relationship with PM as 'trash'
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers pushes back on reports of a rift, saying they've talked almost every day since the budget was handed down.

items.title: Zelenskyy warns 'Moscow will burn' as Russian capital comes under attack
items.description: Scores of drones targeted Moscow overnight in what was Ukraine's largest attack on the Russian capital.

items.title: North Queensland reacts to Rinehart's idea of giving islands to Musk
items.description: The Townsville Enterprise chief executive says "all ideas are welcome" after mining magnate Gina Rinehart suggested islands off North Queensland's coast should be offered to SpaceX CEO Elon Musk for satellite launches.

items.title: Third person charged over Melbourne synagogue fire
items.description: Police have charged a 20-year-old from Melbourne's north-west with a number of charges including arson over a fire that destroyed the Adass Israel Synagogue in 2024.

items.title: Live: Horrific injury mars Canadian celebrations, Mexico leads against South Korea
items.description: Canada claims its first ever win at a World Cup, but celebrations against Qatar have been soured by a broken leg suffered by Ismael Kone. Follow live.

items.title: Andy Burnham poised to challenge UK PM after 'circus' by-election win
items.description: Andy Burnham, a British Labour lifer, is expected to challenge Sir Keir Starmer for the country's top job after re-entering the House of Commons via a by-election.

items.title: Obama centre opens with star-studded crowd but no Trump
items.description: All living US ex-presidents, with the notable absence of Donald Trump, have joined a star-studded line-up for the opening of Barack Obama's presidential centre in Chicago.

items.title: More soft plastics needed as Australia's recycling capacity booms
items.description: Australia's soft plastics recycling industry is now operating at nearly triple the capacity it was at REDcycle's peak, but consumers are yet to be convinced.

items.title: Wife of AFL legend Tony Modra thanks first responders 'who saved his life'
items.description: The wife of AFL icon Tony Modra has expressed her gratitude to emergency services and hospital staff as the Crows legend remains in hospital in a "critical but stable condition" following a truck crash in South Australia.

items.title: Albanese government finds itself in policy quicksand on three core issues
items.description: The government's announced changes to its tax package are seeking to allay the fierce post-budget backlash from vested interests and some commentators.

items.title: The pros and cons of retiring overseas with your pension
items.description: With some foreign countries offering cheaper living expenses, it is no surprise that moving overseas to retire is increasingly attractive to some older Australians. But before you up stumps and book that flight, read this.

items.title: Friday news quiz: Soccer celebrations, bin battles, phone fails and an internet-famous duck
items.description: Today's news quiz is heating up like El Niño. Will you strut like an internet-famous duck or get schooled like Prince George?

items.title: No princesses, no musical numbers: How Toy Story changed children's cinema
items.description: The multi-billion-dollar franchise has overcome rewrites, accidental deletions and generations of changing tastes to bring Toy Story 5 to cinemas in 2026.

items.title: Lal Lal Falls runs dry as upstream 'greed' sees water vanish
items.description: Indigenous and environmental groups are accusing a Chinese company of hoarding water on a Victorian property and causing a sacred waterfall to run dry.

items.title: Hanson's 'scary' parental leave views outdated, advocates say
items.description: Pauline Hanson's openness to discuss a winding back of paid parental leave is concerning and harks back to an Australia that no longer exists, advocates say.

items.title: New data shines light on state of EV public charger network
items.description: It's often claimed Australia has an EV public charger shortage, but analysis of exclusive data shows most fast charger sites are not congested.

items.title: 'Sleepwalking into a catastrophe': Proposed data centre raises water fears
items.description: To its supporters, this proposed data centre will provide much-needed regional jobs, but in the nation's driest state, critics say the draw on river water to cool the machines could be too great.

items.title: Man arrested after boy critically injured in crocodile enclosure at UK zoo
items.description: British police say they have arrested a man on suspicion of attempted murder after being called to a popular zoo north of London.

items.title: Sandilands says billionaires 'come out of the woodwork' ahead of new show
items.description: Radio shock jock Kyle Sandilands reveals the details of his next move after accepting a "piddly little" settlement of $12 million in his contract dispute with ARN Media.

items.title: Inquest to probe Adelaide fashion icon's death after using magic mushrooms
items.description: The death of an Adelaide fashion industry icon who suffered a cardiac arrest after taking magic mushrooms as an alternative treatment will be probed at a coronial inquest.

items.title: Photographers 'ruining' personal moments during World Cup anthems
items.description: Photographers have been allowed to get very close to the coaches during national anthems at the World Cup, but not everyone is happy.
